name: Summer Camp at Camp Fire North Shore
description_short: Day camp at the Camp Fire North Shore program site in Salem for youth entering grades K to 9, in three groups: Explore Camp (K to 4) with daily swim lessons in an outdoor pool, gardening and STEM; Discovery Camp (5 to 6) with two field trips a week; and Adventure Camp (7 to 9) with two days a week of offsite trips. Camp day 9 to 4, with 7:30 to 5:30 care included.
swim_waterfront_notes: Outdoor pool, lifeguard supervised, with daily swim instruction included for Explore Camp.
special_needs_notes: Staff to child ratio 1:10, with additional supports arranged through the intake process.
refund_policy_summary: Deposit of $25 per session is non-refundable and non-transferable. Registration fee $20 per child or $30 per family.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer camp page, 2026: camp June 29 to August 28, 2026; all programs at the Program Facility, 2 Cain Road, Salem. Hours 7:30 to 5:30 with extended hours included; free breakfast, lunch and afternoon snack through the USDA Summer Food Service Program. Explore Camp (entering K to 4) $325 a week, $260 Week 1. Discovery (5 to 6) and Adventure (7 to 9) $375 a week, $300 Week 1, $400 for Super Fun Field Trip Weeks 2 to 5. Sessions list the Explore Camp price; week dates are the nine Monday to Friday weeks from June 29, the page prices Week 1 lower with the note 'no camp July 4'. Ages derived from entering grades K to 9. 'Updated dates and registration fees will be released in 2027.' Phone is the main office line in the footer (90 Munroe St, Lynn).
